reviewer: Independent Astra native and final gate-correction review
verdict: SHIP for the reviewed components; repository and installed-release gates are separate

checks: A native prompt paused during admission stays in its original conversation
A delayed old callback released after actual clear receives exact native rejection
Rejected text enters neither native user-message history nor model context
Owner input reaches the replacement conversation and old readiness remains revoked
Disabling the independent companion guard reproduces late admission
claude.scope_limit: A refused attempt can appear briefly in the native UI and as queue-operation metadata; that is not model or user-message admission

hermes.verdict: SHIP under the conservative ADR037 contract
checks: Exact native receipt reference, authority epoch and canonical resume identity
Queued cancellation and scoped background stop still attempted when an unknown admission exists
Unknown stop or ordinary viewer exit uses non-ending detach
Pinned native SIGTERM cleanup closes transport without an ending detach or owner signal
A/B shared-owner isolation, native permission separation and restart without a new turn
hermes.scope_limit: No joined-work completion proof, automatic workspace cleanup or production credential-refresh claim

checks: ContextGuard continuation fixtures wait for a durably recorded write, with an unwritten-attempt negative
Login-view redaction uses the real credential registry with unchanged public serialization assertions
Enrollment fixture retries are bounded and limited to ErrUnavailable, retaining real stopped-writer checks and terminal cleanup
Child environment fixture publishes by atomic rename and retains allowlist/leak assertions
Unused Hermes viewer helper removed; fixture exercises the actual non-ending exit path

limits: No production sessions or credentials were touched by these reviews
Local mock Discord was expressly authorized by the owner; live bot credentials were not configured
Frozen repository-wide gates, release CI and installed artifacts require their own evidence

constructor_review.scope: Publish roster/fanout/sweeper/journal workers only after immutable field initialization; safe unstarted close and failure cleanup
constructor_review.findings: No missed initial roster, new deadlock or subscription leak; all constructors and private callers audited

release_manifest_review.scope: Advertise maximum supported session read schema5 while classic writes remain1 and login writes remain4
checks: Real Hermes Save/Load matches current compatibility card
Schema4 activation and rollback refuse before execution
